collection.title: 原创素材工坊
collection.description: 持续扩展的多主题、多类型原创 3D 素材库

assets.title: Pinefold Trail Pack
assets.description: Original tapered hiking backpack with rolltop, front pocket, paired buckles, side pouches, open shoulder loops and top carry handle. Shared matte palette; no external textures.

assets.title: Pinefold Trail Canteen
assets.description: Original flattened canteen with screw cap, raised grip bars, wrap webbing and a separate polygonal carrying loop. Shared matte palette; no external textures.

assets.title: Pinefold Folding Chair
assets.description: Original folding camping chair with crossed side frames, pivot pins, sagging cloth seat, separate back canvas and armrests. Shared matte palette; no external textures.

assets.title: Pinefold Campfire Ring
assets.description: Original low-poly campfire prop with eight irregular hearth rocks, crossed logs, visible cut ends and four curved polygonal flame shells. Flame geometry is decorative and has no heat or particle simulation. Shared matte palette; no external textures.

assets.title: Pinefold Carry Lantern
assets.description: Original squat portable camping lantern with protective cage, opaque warm chamber, cap vents, rotary knob and polygonal carry hoop. Shared matte palette; no external textures.

assets.title: Pinefold Campsite Scene
assets.description: Original campsite composition of the Pinefold tent, chairs, lantern, backpack, canteen, picnic table, campfire and trail marker on a faceted island. Reuses original prop designs; decorative scene, not camping safety guidance.

assets.title: Pinefold Picnic Table
assets.description: Original five-plank picnic table with two slatted benches, twin A-frame supports, cross beams and visible joinery pegs. Shared matte palette; no external textures.

assets.title: Pinefold A-Frame Tent
assets.description: Original A-frame canvas tent with open folded flaps, genuine hollow interior, structural poles, guy ropes and ground pegs. Shared matte palette; no external textures.

assets.title: Pinefold Trail Marker
assets.description: Original forked trail marker with two opposing arrow boards, visible pegs, triangular mountain pictogram and a ground sleeve. Shared matte palette; no external textures.

assets.title: Bilgewood Storage Barrel
assets.description: Original twelve-stave bilged barrel with inset head, slim forged hoops, and cooper bung. Matte shared palette; no textures.

assets.title: Tideway Slatted Bench
assets.description: Original three-slat dock bench with two-plank back, splayed legs, cross stretcher and four matte teal join pins.

assets.title: Gathered Dock Sack
assets.description: Original asymmetric canvas cargo sack with a flat base, gathered tied neck, cord tails and sewn tide-mark bars.

assets.title: Tideway Cargo Crate
assets.description: Original beveled plank cargo crate with a three-bar tide mark. Matte shared palette; no external textures.

assets.title: Two Meter Pier Tile
assets.description: Original exact 2m square pier module with ten deck planks, twin stringers, four timber pilings and matte collars. Top deck at 0.75m for snapping.

assets.title: Quayside Carry Lantern
assets.description: Original compact dock lantern with timber plinth, opaque warm diffuser, pitched cap and carry loop. Matte shared palette.

assets.title: Tidewatch Rescue Ring
assets.description: Original open flotation ring with four muted coral wraps, perimeter rescue line and four attachment ties.

assets.title: Coiled Mooring Line
assets.description: Original continuous three-turn mooring rope with real gaps, exposed tail, end faces and a loose matte keeper.

assets.title: Two Way Pier Sign
assets.description: Original freestanding timber wayfinding post with two opposite softened arrows and abstract tide-mark direction glyphs; no language-specific text.

assets.title: Maple Booth Module
assets.description: Original modular seafoam dining booth with a solid maple plinth, attached backrest and ivory trim. Repeat at 1.2 m X spacing, front -Y and backrest +Y; self-contained instances need no shared-part removal, with intentional beveled seams.

assets.title: Quiet Corner Dining Set
assets.description: Original modular dining vignette with booth, round table, chair, freestanding lattice divider, service counter and a ceramic mug. Self-contained procedural source.

assets.title: Freestanding Lattice Divider
assets.description: Original freestanding modular dining divider with maple posts, seafoam slats, ivory crossrails and two wide stabilizing feet. Repeat freestanding units along X at 1.2 m spacing, or rotate about Z. Broad faces are +/-Y. Feet determine the pitch and meet at the module boundary; the upright frames intentionally retain an 8 cm gap. Each instance is complete with its own stabilizers; no shared-part deletion or mesh welding is needed.

assets.title: Open Service Counter
assets.description: Original multiuse dining service counter with two open shelves, solid side supports and a broad maple top. Repeat along X at 1.34 m spacing. Open shelves face -Y; rear panel is +Y. Top widths align; the 1.30 m base leaves a 4 cm seam and the 1.28 m side-panel envelope leaves a 6 cm seam. Each instance is complete; no shared-part deletion or mesh welding is needed.

assets.title: Maple Prep Board
assets.description: Original rounded maple chopping board with contrasting inset grain strips and a hanging-hole handle.

assets.title: Hearth Dining Chair
assets.description: Original maple and seafoam dining chair with three ivory back slats, four legs and real supporting stretchers.

assets.title: Sunday Skillet
assets.description: Original shallow seafoam skillet with ivory rim, dark cooking surface and broad wooden grip.

assets.title: The Little Hearth Kitchen
assets.description: Original compact kitchen vignette with a two-burner stove, working-height sink cabinet, maple prep station and six separately editable cookware props.

assets.title: Bakers Measure
assets.description: Original deep seafoam measuring scoop with an ivory rolled lip and short maple handle.

assets.title: Maple Mixing Bowl
assets.description: Original thick-walled wooden mixing bowl with a cream rim and seafoam foot ring.

assets.title: Herb Mortar and Pestle
assets.description: Original ivory mortar with a deep open bowl, seafoam pedestal and a separate tapered maple pestle resting alongside.

assets.title: Morning Tea Mug
assets.description: Original ivory ceramic mug with a seafoam foot, curved maple-color loop and a genuinely hollow interior.

assets.title: Pantry Prep Corner
assets.description: Original pantry worktable vignette with mixing bowl, herb mortar, chopping board, cup, measure and a low maple step stool. Fully self-contained generation script.

assets.title: Gathering Round Table
assets.description: Original compact round maple table with a seafoam cross-frame, four stout legs and ivory leveling feet.

assets.title: Washday Sink Cabinet
assets.description: Original seafoam sink cabinet with inset ivory basin, bent mixer faucet and warm wooden door details.

assets.title: Hearth Slotted Turner
assets.description: Original seafoam slotted turner with four real open slots, ivory collar and maple grip.

assets.title: Little Pantry Stool
assets.description: Original compact maple step stool with a seafoam lower step, ivory rails and four splayed supports.

assets.title: Hearth Enamel Stockpot
assets.description: Original open seafoam enamel stockpot with rolled ivory rim, visible inner basin and paired maple loop handles.

assets.title: Hearth Two Burner Stove
assets.description: Original compact ivory stove with seafoam side casing, two detailed burners, maple knobs and inset oven door.

assets.title: Pantry Wall Shelf
assets.description: Original maple wall shelf with two triangular seafoam support cheeks and three ivory utility hooks.

assets.title: Meadow Stacked Beehive
assets.description: Original raised timber beehive with stacked supers, pitched weatherproof lid, flight board, recessed entrance and four legs. Closed exterior prop.

assets.title: Meadow Gable Cottage
assets.description: Original compact closed exterior cottage with timber-framed plaster, gable roof, stone doorstep, chimney, shuttered windows and a framed door. Exterior-only background architecture; bottom-centre placement.

assets.title: Meadow Farm Workyard
assets.description: Original farm workyard combining a supported firewood storage bay, a thick-walled water trough and three approach stones on a meadow slab. Standalone generator with complete verified support graph.

assets.title: Meadow Right-Angle Fence
assets.description: Original right-angle timber corner with a shared central post and two one-metre fence wings. Corner origin is the central post foot; endpoints at (1,0) and (0,1).

assets.title: Meadow Hinged Gate
assets.description: Original two-metre gateway with hinged timber gate, diagonal sag brace and visible iron latch. End posts at x=-1 and +1 metres match the field fence grid.

assets.title: Meadow Two-Metre Fence
assets.description: Original timber field fence with pointed posts, two rails and staggered pickets. Snaps at post centres x=-1 and +1 metres; GLB is a joined mesh: edit out one duplicate terminal post for each joint; simple 2m instancing overlaps terminal posts.

assets.title: Meadow Porch Planter
assets.description: Original raised plank flower box with contrasting corner feet, inset soil and three low-poly flowering plants.

assets.title: Meadow Arched Footbridge
assets.description: Original short pedestrian footbridge with shallow arched plank deck, segmented support stringers and handrails. Ground origin; approximately 2.6m span, one-metre deck.

assets.title: Meadow Harvest Handcart
assets.description: Original two-wheel harvest handcart with open plank bed, spoked timber wheels, metal tyres, handles and a standing support.

assets.title: Meadow Firewood Shelter
assets.description: Original open-front firewood shelter with sloped weather roof, supporting frame and six stacked round logs. Exterior utility prop with actual roof supports.

assets.title: Meadow Produce Stall
assets.description: Original open market stall with pitched striped timber canopy, front display counter and two divided produce trays. Walk-in access at rear.

assets.title: Meadow Village Noticeboard
assets.description: Original timber public noticeboard with three blank paper notices, fitted pegs and a weather cap. Static sign prop without text or external textures.

assets.title: Round Orchard Tree
assets.description: Original broadleaf orchard tree with forked trunk, three faceted crown masses and visible surface roots. Ground-centred placement.

assets.title: Meadow Picnic Table
assets.description: Original picnic table with two integrated slatted benches, longitudinal brace and eight grounded legs. All seat and tabletop supports are modeled.

assets.title: Meadow Stepping Path
assets.description: Original two-metre path module with irregular beveled paving stones and open grass gaps. Tile at 2 metre X intervals; ground-centre origin.

assets.title: Willow Stone Well
assets.description: Original hollow coursed-stone village well with pitched timber canopy, spindle, crank and suspended bucket.

assets.title: Meadow Kitchen Garden Bed
assets.description: Original raised vegetable plot with joined timber frame, supported soil and six leafy carrot plants. Compact editable garden prop.

assets.title: Meadow Stone Water Trough
assets.description: Original open monolithic stone livestock trough with thick walls, recessed water and two low feet. Basin is one closed manifold wall-and-floor mesh.

assets.title: Meadow Well Courtyard
assets.description: Original compact village vignette combining a hollow stone well, orchard tree, timber fence, stepping approach and meadow shrubs on a five-metre base. Reproducible standalone generator; editable component objects.

assets.title: Maple Archway Wall
assets.description: Original 1.4 m grid architectural module with a real open arched doorway, maple reveal and seafoam threshold. Repeat wall instances along X at 1.4 m spacing, Z up. Maple trim faces -Y. Overall wall height is 2.4 m; structural opening width 0.9 m and crown 2.1 m; maple reveals leave 0.844 m clear width at the straight jambs. Each module is complete and needs no shared-part deletion.

assets.title: Open Window Wall
assets.description: Original 1.4 m grid wall module with a genuine open rectangular window, maple surround and seafoam crossbars. Repeat along X at 1.4 m spacing. Wall height 2.4 m, trim faces -Y; the structural 0.9 by 0.95 m window is open and unglazed, with maple trim on both faces. Each module is complete; preserve exterior seams and do not weld or remove neighboring parts.

assets.title: Maple Floor Tile
assets.description: Original 1.4 m square dining floor module with six solid maple planks on a seafoam foundation and two lighter boards. Repeat at 1.4 m spacing along X and Y. Six planks run along Y with intentional 12 mm board seams and a narrow foundation border. Bottom-center origin; finished height 0.045 m. Each tile is complete and needs no shared-part deletion.

assets.title: Meadow Anvil on Stump
assets.description: Original village smith anvil with tapered horn, heel, modeled waist and foot mounted on a grounded timber stump with two iron bindings. Static unrigged prop.

assets.title: Meadow Direction Sign
assets.description: Original triple-arrow timber wayfinding post with three blank boards and visible iron fixings. Meter-scale static village prop.

assets.title: Meadow Gathering Corner
assets.description: Original compact village meeting scene with a picnic table, public noticeboard and rounded grass base. Separate editable source parts and a single self-contained export.

assets.title: Meadow Hand Water Pump
assets.description: Original cast-metal manual village water pump with modeled lever, axle, wooden grip and downturned spout. Static unrigged prop.

assets.title: Meadow Low Masonry Wall Module
assets.description: Original 2.04 meter wide low stone wall module with four lower ashlar blocks, three staggered upper blocks, continuous footing and fitted coping.

assets.title: Meadow Nursery Corner
assets.description: Original village nursery scene with three planted wooden trays and a two-tier timber stand on stone paving. The upper and lower trays are supported on shelves; the ready-to-plant tray rests on the paving.

assets.title: Meadow Two-Tier Nursery Rack
assets.description: Original freestanding two-tier timber nursery rack with four grounded legs, two plant shelves and an inset back rail. Sized to support the matching seedling trays.

assets.title: Meadow Seedling Tray
assets.description: Original small wooden seed tray containing six modeled seedlings, soil, inset end boards and a solid bottom. Each leaf connects to a stem and soil-supported root.

assets.title: Meadow Smith Work Corner
assets.description: Original compact village workshop scene featuring an anvil on timber stump, three-tool hanging rack and a low trestle carrying metal stock on stone paving.

assets.title: Meadow Raised Stone Lookout
assets.description: Original raised village stoop demonstration combining four stone steps, an independently supported landing and a low masonry parapet on a meadow base. Separate blocks intentionally retain small installation seams.

assets.title: Meadow Four-Step Stone Module
assets.description: Original four-tier stone stair module ascending along positive Y, with slightly inset successive tiers and a 0.69 meter top tread. Each tier is modeled and structurally supported.

assets.title: Meadow Workshop Tool Rack
assets.description: Original freestanding timber tool rack with iron pins, hammer, wooden mallet and chisel. Each handle and tool head has modeled structural support.

assets.title: Meadow Village Water Point
assets.description: Original public water-point scene combining a hand pump, triple-arrow wayfinding post and recessed stone drain with iron grate on a cobbled plinth.

assets.title: Work Skiff Launch Point
assets.description: Original shoreline launch display with a work skiff, modular ramp, shore bank and an independent opaque water-surface node. Hull bottom sits 0.12 m below water surface; boat is displayed afloat, not physically simulated or ground-supported. The static water cavity is bound to the current boat placement; change BOAT_POSITION and regenerate the water mesh before repositioning the boat.

assets.title: Cargo Trike Loading Stop
assets.description: Original loading-stop composition containing one three-wheel cargo trike, two whole short platform modules and a 4.0 by 3.8 m paved pad. Separate components remain editable; no animation or physics.

assets.title: Three Wheel Cargo Trike
assets.description: Original static cargo tricycle with single front and paired rear wheels, separate tires, hubs, axles, forks, chassis, saddle, steering controls and open cargo box. Wheel axles follow source X; vehicle faces -Y. Editable parts; no animation or physics.

assets.title: Triple Loop Cycle Rack
assets.description: Original 1.8 m repeat-pitch bicycle parking module with three seafoam hoops, cream ballast rails and ochre mounting collars. Repeat complete instances along X; origin bottom center, source Z up. No shared-part deletion is needed.

assets.title: Short Launch Ramp
assets.description: Original 1.6 m repeat-width launch ramp with solid inclined deck, two side guides and six raised grip strips. Length 2.4 m; low/high deck edges 0.12/0.72 m. Repeat complete modules along X.

assets.title: Cycle Parking Corner
assets.description: Original street-corner composition with two complete three-hoop cycle racks, one double-sided road barrier, a warm paving slab and a closed L-shaped curb. Empty parking display on a 4.2 by 3.0 m footprint.

assets.title: Soft Corner Road Barrier
assets.description: Original freestanding road barricade with two wide stabilizing feet, braced uprights and a double-sided ochre board carrying cream diagonal markings. A stylized game prop.

assets.title: Short Loading Platform
assets.description: Original 1.4 m repeat-pitch loading platform with two grounded foundations, cream deck and raised rear safety curb. Repeat full modules along source X.

assets.title: Flat Bottom Work Skiff
assets.description: Original open flat-bottom work skiff with a closed thick hull, continuous separate gunwale, two seat boards and a resting two-part paddle. Editable source components. Design display waterline is 0.12 m above hull bottom, not a hydrostatic simulation.

assets.title: Quiet Arrival Corner
assets.description: Original composed entryway vignette on four 1.4 m floor tiles, featuring a storage bench, five-peg freestanding rack and three-bay cubby tower. A collision-separated layout for hallway, apartment or shop reference scenes. Furniture feet intentionally overlap finished floor by 8 mm for robust support.

assets.title: Ribbed Boot Tray
assets.description: Original shallow seafoam boot tray with closed base and four joined raised sides, seven ivory drainage ribs and maple end grips. For entryways, utility rooms, gardening corners or prop storage.

assets.title: Three Bay Cubby Tower
assets.description: Original compact three-bay open storage tower with enclosed back and three ivory shelf surfaces on a maple plinth. For entryways, bedrooms, workshops and small retail displays.

assets.title: Freestanding Peg Rail
assets.description: Original freestanding hallway peg rack with two stable feet, twin uprights, ivory shoulder rail and five upward maple pegs. Usable as a coat rack, shop display or craft-room organizer.

assets.title: Maple Entry Bench
assets.description: Original open under-seat entry bench with three seat boards, two broad side supports, central cubby partition and ivory shoe shelf. For hallway, bedroom, studio or shop interiors.

assets.title: Slatted Umbrella Bin
assets.description: Original open twelve-stave umbrella bin with a closed maple base, seafoam upper hoop and ivory lower hoop. Empty container for hallway, studio or shop use.

assets.title: Faceted Fallen Log
assets.description: Original reusable fallen log with flat ground-support facet, two broken branches and solid cut-end materials. Length 2.6 m; local X follows the log axis.

assets.title: Fallen Log Stream Crossing
assets.description: Original natural fallen-log crossing over a 90-degree shallow stream, reusing the independent log and bank corner module. The trunk is supported by both banks. GroundAndNature and WaterSurface_Runtime are separate GLB nodes for independent water material replacement; water top Z=0.16m, centerline bend radius 2m.

assets.title: Soft Woodland Mushroom Clusters
assets.description: Original three clusters containing nine faceted mushrooms, with tapered grounded stems, warm caps and distinct cream undersides. Separate editable source parts; no external textures.

assets.title: Soft Woodland Shallow Stream
assets.description: Original shallow stream woodland scene using four matched rocky bank modules, three mushroom clusters and two conifer saplings. Runtime GLB keeps GroundAndNature and WaterSurface_Runtime as separate named meshes for independent material replacement. Bank modules repeat every 2 m along X; water top is Z=0.16 m with 0.07 m thickness.

assets.title: Soft Woodland Stream Bank Module
assets.description: Original rocky stream-bank module with a fixed 2 meter X repeat interval. Stream-facing edge is local Y=0 at Z=.06m; landward edge is Y=1.2m at Z=.55m. End profiles match exactly at X=-1 and +1; rocks stay clear of both interfaces.

assets.title: Rocky Stream Corner
assets.description: Original 90-degree shallow-stream corner. Centerline radius 2 m; pivot (-1.75,-1.75)m; centerline ports (0.25,-1.75)m and (-1.75,0.25)m, tangent axes Y and X. Bank cross-sections match the 2m-repeat straight bank with a +0.09m height offset for the integrated base. GroundAndNature and WaterSurface_Runtime are separate GLB nodes; water top Z=0.16m.

assets.title: Telescope Observing Corner
assets.description: Original observing corner with a separately editable tripod telescope and two stacked equipment case modules. Upper case feet bear on lower top rails, validated by real opposing surface points. Visual game prop, no optics or physics simulation.

assets.title: Stackable Observation Case
assets.description: Original observation equipment case module with side carry handle, latches and two top bearing rails aligned to four underside feet. Stack complete modules at 0.36 m vertical pitch; side handle stays clear.

assets.title: Tripod Observing Telescope
assets.description: Original stylized telescope with separate editable optical tube, shade, lens discs, eyepiece, mounting collar, pivot, yoke, tripod legs and grounded pads. Plausible visual arrangement only; no real optical performance or engineering specifications are claimed.

assets.title: Open Neck Ceramic Amphora
assets.description: Original tall low-poly ceramic amphora with an open mouth, continuous thick closed shell, inner floor and two editable shoulder loop handles.

assets.title: Pottery Turntable Workbench
assets.description: Original pottery workbench module with four grounded legs, lower shelf, separate axle and flat turntable plate. Editable game visual asset without mechanical simulation.

assets.title: Pottery Work Corner
assets.description: Original pottery corner with a thick-shell amphora seated on a workbench turntable and another on the floor. Three real opposed surface anchors validate the vessel on the plate.
